final_answer: Condition C2 was compared with vector RAG (SS) on comprehensiveness for both the Podcast and News datasets. For the Podcast dataset, all global search conditions, including C2, had greater comprehensiveness than SS, and these differences were statistically significant (p < .05) [2]. Similarly, for the News dataset, all global search conditions, including C2, had greater comprehensiveness than SS, with these differences also being statistically significant (p < .05) [2]. However, the specific win rates or percentages for C2 alone were not provided in the sources.
